resolution: Built the missing unwrapper. Root cause chain established across the thread: generated layouts never had UNFOLDING — req_3426 folded faces into dominant-axis buckets (big islands, cosine-squeezed density), req_3726 (Aug 2) fixed the density/rotation bug with strict coplanar intrinsic charts and collaterally shredded every curved in-studio mesh into per-quad confetti (the van seat retopo: 531 faces → 510 islands; even a cube was 6 islands, never the cross). Neither rule could unfold a 90° edge. paint_islands.zig generation lane now grows charts by HINGE UNROLL: rigid rotation+translation lays each neighbouring authored face flat across the shared manifold edge, growth stops only at folds past 92°, non-manifold edges, and genuine 2D self-overlap (shrunk-triangle SAT on a hash grid). Isometric per face, so req_3726's law is kept exactly (physical density, rotation-invariant) while a cube now unfolds into the classic 64x48 cross, a hexagon cylinder into one 96x16 strip, and a curved retopo band into one 32x16 rectangle — tests pin all three plus a 120-degree crease staying a seam. Authored-UV reconstruction (imports with real UVs, saved layouts) keeps its exact historical rule; painting unaffected (corner-UV mapping, zero basis like the reconstructed lane). 12/12 paint_islands, 54/54 model-paint, 165/165 mesh-edit. Needs dev-host rebuild + Remake Atlas on the seat to see the band-strip islands.
